title: Super Mario World Styled Super Mario RPG Enemies (Bob-Omb, Lava Bubble, Lakitu, Spikey, Wiggler)
description:
A GFX02 that makes enemies look more like their Super Mario RPG counterparts while keeping the Super Mario World style. Spiny becomes Spikey, Hopping Flame becomes Lava Bubble, Wiggler smiles and is rounder, Lakitu is yellow with a green shell, and Bob-Omb has a cap and wind-up key. Does not require custom palettes, but includes a palette with palmask which (re-)imports the required vanilla colours and fills missing information into palettes C and D if you do have plans to use them for these.

Please use STEAR to change Lakitu's, Bob-Omb's, Bubble (Bob-omb's) and Para-Bomb's palettes to work with these reskins, and Asar to apply the patch included for changes to Wiggler's flower and angry eye offsets and the number of body segments.
